capabilities: Store fold states in the plugin's data.json inside the vault
Apply saved folds when the plugin loads or when data.json changes from another device
Save fold and unfold changes with a 150 ms debounce
Export fold states from local storage to data.json via a command
Import fold states from data.json into local storage via a command
disambiguation: Not a vault sync plugin itself; it only saves fold states inside the vault so existing sync services carry them.
extras: Requires no configuration; install it on every device that shares the vault. Export/import commands exist for devices that get out of step. Works on desktop and mobile, requires Obsidian 0.15.0 or later.
problem: Obsidian keeps fold states in each device's localStorage, so folds made on one device never appear on another.

relations.evidence: Obsidian Sync: turn on Installed community plugins under Settings → Sync → Vault configuration sync.

requires.name: any vault sync service (Obsidian Sync, iCloud, Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive, Git, Syncthing, Nextcloud, CouchDB)

summary: Stores heading, list and property fold states in the vault's data.json so they stay the same across devices via any sync service.
